editorial:
You know that feeling when two people who could not be more different are forced to work together? That is the heart of this buddy cop comedy. Sarah Ashburn is a by-the-book FBI agent who thinks she is always right. Shannon Mullins is a loud, rough Boston cop who trusts her gut over any rulebook. When they team up to take down a drug lord, sparks fly in every direction. The vibe is loud, silly, and packed with insults that somehow turn into real friendship. You will laugh at their constant bickering and root for them to finally get along.

Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy carry the whole thing with great chemistry. The action is fun and the jokes land often, though some gags go on a bit too long. If you like buddy comedies with strong female leads, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Ashburn and Mullins track the drug lord to a warehouse. They discover the mole is actually Ashburn's boss, who has been working with the cartel. After a chaotic shootout, the two partners take him down together. Mullins saves Ashburn's life, proving their bond is real. The movie ends with them celebrating as true friends, finally having someone who gets them. It is a satisfying, feel-good finish that rewards their growth.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy comedies with strong female leads.
